problem_profile.summary: Execute and verify the Better Harness improvement plan without losing dirty work, weakening quality gates, breaking trace continuity, duplicating dependency truth, or drifting Skill content.
assumptions: The repository remains a script-oriented application unless DG-03 explicitly changes that intent.
Python 3.9 compatibility remains the minimum during this program unless DG-02 explicitly approves an uplift.
No student-private data may be committed or logged.
Remote GitHub mutation requires explicit user authorization.
constraints: Use one dependency source of truth.
Do not weaken Ruff or mypy merely to make CI green.
Do not alter approval, publication, Agent Gateway, or canonical-answer trust boundaries.
Use isolated temporary libraries for E2E and smoke tests.
Keep recovery artifacts until at least one week after owner acceptance.
excluded_scope: Guaranteed Learning Capture score increase from a single episode

targets.description: The execution baseline and human decisions are current, fingerprinted, and auditable.
success_criteria: Authoritative inputs, tools, HEAD, and findings are re-fingerprinted
All critical decision gates have an explicit owner decision

targets.description: All approved dirty work and implementation changes have verified recovery boundaries and logical commits.
success_criteria: Approved working-tree bytes can be recovered
Each logical group is independently revertible
No unexplained dirty path remains

targets.description: Ruff and mypy are zero locally and mandatory in CI.
success_criteria: Full Ruff exits zero
Full mypy exits zero
CI clean passes and lint/type canaries fail

targets.description: The six W3 and correctness modules emit privacy-safe trace-linked diagnostic events.
success_criteria: Named child logging formats correctly
Trace crosses thread-pool boundaries without leaking
A fake W3 run has one complete trace
Privacy sentinel never appears

targets.description: A clean environment installs one Python dependency source of truth and can run the application and tools.
success_criteria: Dependency inventory covers every third-party import
Fresh venv install and smoke suite pass
CI contains no second hand-maintained package list

targets.description: Qoder discovers the approved Skills while Claude, Codex, and Qoder share canonical content.
success_criteria: Qoder reports at least eight Skills
Two representative Skills trigger
All consumer hashes match the canonical source

targets.description: The change history and Better Harness evidence are comparable across logical episodes.
success_criteria: Logical commits and test evidence are linked
A same-condition closure comparison exists
Learning Capture remains provisional until two episodes exist

targets.description: The integrated project preserves behavior, privacy, architecture boundaries, and graph health.
success_criteria: Full unit and isolated E2E suites pass
Privacy and logging tests pass
Graphify health is recorded
No production library or publication artifact changes

nodes.label: Quality-gated worktree
invariants: No scope shrink or global-ignore escape

atomic_tasks.description: Fingerprint authoritative plan, findings, configuration, governance inputs, tool versions, HEAD, and branch.
Snapshot tracked, untracked, ignored, staged, stash, tag, and privacy-scan state without printing sensitive content.
Reproduce every Better Harness finding against the frozen workspace and mark it confirmed, stale, expanded, or unsupported.
Approve the preservation, Python, dependency, Skill allowlist, and remote-canary decisions.
Classify every dirty path exactly once as commit, ignore, defer, or sensitive and assign approved commit groups.
Create a named recovery object including approved untracked files, restore it immediately, and verify file hashes.
Add precise ignore rules only for approved generated artifacts while preserving .qoder/skills visibility.
Partition preserved files into disjoint runtime, evaluation, documentation, and Skill commit groups.
Verify each commit group with its scoped tests, diff check, and privacy scan before staging.
Commit only the approved runtime and matching test group.
Commit only the approved evaluation scripts and their evidence reports.
Commit only the approved documents, plans, contracts, and examples.
Commit only canonical Skill content and approved compatibility links.
Verify recovery-object readability, logical commit revertability, and an explainable working tree.
Freeze quality scan scope, Python semantics, override rules, and anti-gaming constraints.
Apply only safe Ruff autofixes to a frozen explicit file list and review the behavioral diff.
Repair remaining Ruff violations manually without changing behavior or weakening rules.
Specify trace ownership, event names, required fields, log levels, privacy blacklist, and exception ownership for six modules.
Repair shared logging so named child loggers receive trace_id, nested contexts restore the parent, and current trace is readable.
Propagate the parent trace into W3 thread-pool workers and clear it after worker completion.
Instrument W3 pipeline with the approved privacy-safe trace-linked events while modifying only teacher-console/w3_pipeline.py.
Instrument Evidence Agent with the approved privacy-safe trace-linked events while modifying only teacher-console/evidence_agent.py.
Instrument cognitive loop with the approved privacy-safe trace-linked events while modifying only teacher-console/cognitive_loop.py.
Instrument correctness faults with the approved privacy-safe trace-linked events while modifying only teacher-console/correctness_faults.py.
Instrument Claim Ledger with the approved privacy-safe trace-linked events while modifying only teacher-console/claim_ledger.py.
Instrument proof aggregation with the approved privacy-safe trace-linked events while modifying only teacher-console/proof_aggregation.py.
Test six-module event coverage, trace continuity, exception attribution, volume bounds, and privacy sentinels behaviorally.
Run one isolated fake W3 request and prove one trace spans server, worker stages, evidence, loop, ledger, and proof modules.
Inventory Python imports and classify distributions as runtime, development, optional, standard-library, or project-local.
Select the single dependency declaration form and Python support policy after a clean-environment spike.
Declare one Python dependency source of truth with separate runtime and development layers.
Install the dependency source in a fresh temporary venv and smoke import, startup, tests, Ruff, and mypy.
Freeze the public Skill allowlist, canonical source path, consumer directories, and representation policy.
Register approved Qoder Skills from the canonical .claude source using links or a versioned hash-guarded fallback.
Verify Qoder discovers at least eight Skills, two Skills trigger, and all consumer representations match canonical hashes.
Classify the latest mypy errors into five disjoint file-owner partitions after logging and dependency changes.
Repair mypy errors in the frozen runtime file partition without modifying another owner's files.
Repair mypy errors in the frozen W3 and evidence file partition without modifying another owner's files.
Repair mypy errors in the frozen visualization and publication file partition without modifying another owner's files.
Repair mypy errors in the frozen scripts and command-line tools file partition without modifying another owner's files.
Repair mypy errors in the frozen tests and fixtures file partition without modifying another owner's files.
Aggregate all type partitions and prove full-scope Ruff and mypy both exit zero.
Integrate the single dev dependency source and mandatory Ruff and mypy steps into CI without non-blocking escapes.
Document only verified runtime rules, dependency commands, Skill registration, and change evidence in project truth documents.
Run full unit, isolated E2E, quality, privacy, dependency, logging, and Skill regression suites on the integrated worktree.
Commit only observability infrastructure, six modules, and behavioral logging tests.
Commit only quality repairs, dependency declarations, CI workflow, and their tests.
Commit only Qoder Skill registration and minimal governance documentation.
Verify final Git status, logical commit scopes, independent revertability, and recovery checkpoint retention.
Run an authorized temporary remote CI canary proving clean success and independent lint and type failures.
Update graphify and record health plus focused CI, logging, dependency, and Skill structure queries.
Rerun the same Better Harness version and produce a finding-by-finding closure comparison that preserves unresolved evidence.
Accept completed obligations, retained risks, recovery retention, and the next Learning Capture observation date.

verification_obligations.claim: The implementation program is based on current, fingerprinted evidence and explicit decisions.
verification_obligations.method: Recompute hashes and rerun each finding probe under recorded tool versions.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: All five findings have current evidence and all critical decisions are approved.

verification_obligations.claim: Approved dirty work and implementation commits are recoverable and independently reversible.
verification_obligations.method: Resolve recovery OID, replay hashes, inspect commit scopes, and rehearse independent revertability.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: All approved bytes recover; no sensitive bytes are committed; no unexplained dirty path remains.

verification_obligations.claim: Ruff and mypy are enforced rather than merely configured.
verification_obligations.method: Run full local commands, parse CI YAML, and exercise clean, lint-fail, and type-fail remote canaries.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: Local commands exit zero; clean CI passes; each defect canary fails; no non-blocking escape exists.

verification_obligations.claim: W3 diagnostics retain one trace across named child loggers, nested contexts, and thread-pool workers.
verification_obligations.method: Capture LogRecords in unit and isolated W3 tests and compare trace identifiers and required events.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: No formatter errors; one trace spans all required modules; reused threads do not leak traces.

verification_obligations.claim: New observability does not expose private problem, answer, evidence, or credential content.
verification_obligations.method: Inject unique sentinels into private fields and scan captured messages, arguments, tracebacks, and artifacts.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: Zero private sentinel occurrences and only approved identifiers, counts, statuses, routes, and codes appear.

verification_obligations.claim: The Python dependency declaration is complete, singular, and reproducible in CI and a clean venv.
verification_obligations.method: Map imports to distributions, install into mktemp venv, and run import/start/tool/test smoke commands.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: Every third-party import is classified; clean install passes; CI references the same source with no manual duplicate.

verification_obligations.claim: Qoder can discover approved Skills without introducing uncontrolled content duplication.
verification_obligations.method: Resolve links or guarded mirrors, compare hashes, rerun Qoder asset inventory, and trigger two Skills.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: At least eight Skills discovered; two triggers pass; consumer hashes match canonical.

verification_obligations.claim: The integrated changes preserve project behavior, isolation, privacy, and architectural structure.
verification_obligations.method: Run scoped and full tests, isolated E2E, privacy checks, and graphify health/query checks.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: All critical suites pass; no production data changes; graph warnings are either zero or explicitly unresolved.

verification_obligations.claim: Better Harness improvement evidence is comparable across logical episodes and does not overclaim Learning Capture.
verification_obligations.method: Compare same-version before/after findings and link each change to commits and tests; schedule a second episode.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: All findings have evidence-backed status and Learning Capture stays provisional until two comparable episodes exist.

allocation_notes: Commit tasks are always serialized because they share the Git index.
O33-O38 and Q24-Q28 may run in parallel only with disjoint file ownership.
No executor may concurrently modify pyproject.toml, deploy.yml, log.py, CLAUDE.md, or the Git index.
Role allocation is a handoff plan; no subagent is authorized by this artifact alone.

control_policy.challenge_policy: bind every challenge to one target, interface, or verification obligation and require new evidence
control_policy.hypothesis_policy: keep repair hypotheses isolated until a deterministic probe or scoped test supports them
control_policy.rollback_policy: invalidate and roll back only the smallest dependency impact cone; never reset the repository broadly

aggregation.acceptance_rule: V1-V8 must pass, every target must have an accepted artifact, the owner must approve I76, and V9 must preserve the two-episode Learning Capture condition.
aggregation.conflict_policy: Use the decisive command, recovery drill, privacy test, CI canary, or tool inventory; do not use majority vote or Better Harness score alone.
aggregation.unresolved_policy: Preserve unresolved decisions and external limitations in the closure report and mark the program provisional rather than weakening a gate.

unresolved.item: Final classification of the current 147 untracked paths requires owner approval because they are user work.
unresolved.default: Do not delete; checkpoint before ignore or commit.

unresolved.item: The project has no declared packaging intent.
unresolved.default: Use requirements.txt plus requirements-dev.txt, not a new installable package.

unresolved.item: Dropping Python 3.9 may affect environments not represented by current CI.
unresolved.default: Retain 3.9 compatibility and CI on 3.11 for this program.

unresolved.item: Qoder symlink-following behavior must be verified with the installed Qoder version.
unresolved.resolver: S62 with one bounded S61 representation retry
unresolved.default: Use links first; use only a hash-guarded generated mirror if necessary.

unresolved.item: Remote CI canary requires explicit authorization and Learning Capture needs at least two comparable episodes.
unresolved.resolver: I71 and the observation date recorded by I76
unresolved.default: Deliver provisional if remote mutation is not authorized or the observation window is incomplete.
